faq.question: How long does a SWIFT transfer take to settle?
faq.answer: SWIFT wires typically settle in 3–5 business days depending on the corresponding bank chain. We mark the transaction settled the moment our correspondent confirms receipt.

faq.question: What are your KYC requirements for new accounts?
faq.answer: Standard accounts require government ID, proof of address (less than 3 months old), and a brief source-of-funds declaration. Enhanced Due Diligence applies to accounts above USD 10,000 expected monthly volume.

faq.question: Why was my transaction held for review?
faq.answer: Transactions above USD 10,000 (medium tier) or USD 50,000 (high tier) trigger four-eyes review. Crypto transfers and SWIFT wires also screen against our sanctions and PEP lists before release.

faq.question: Which crypto assets do you support?
faq.answer: We custody BTC, ETH, SOL, and the USDC/USDT stablecoins natively. Other ERC-20 or SPL tokens are not supported in this release.

faq.question: How do I dispute a fee or transaction?
faq.answer: Email complaints@ccash-demo.ch with your transaction reference. We respond within 2 business days and resolve disputes within 15 days per FINMA guidance.
